# nlohmann JSON

Unmodified single header from version 3.12.0:
https://github.com/nlohmann/json/blob/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp

The original MIT license is retained in `LICENSE.MIT` and in the header.
Only the opt-in `rawlab_edit_protocol` target compiles this dependency.
CLI installation includes the license under `share/licenses/rawlab-edit-protocol`.
